param.name: profiles
param.desc: The PDF conformance profiles to validate against (PDFA_1A, PDFA_1B, PDFA_2A, PDFA_2B, PDFA_2U, PDFA_3A, PDFA_3B, PDFA_3U, PDFA_4, PDFA_4E, PDFA_4F, PDFUA_1). If not provided only the core parsing takes place

param.name: strictMode
param.desc: Whether recoverable core parsing issues should be treated as errors rather than warnings (default is false)

param.name: sortBySeverity
param.desc: Whether the report's items should be sorted based on severity (default is true)

param.name: password
param.desc: The password to use to open the PDF document if it is encrypted

param.name: maximumFindingsPerRule
param.desc: The maximum number of findings to report per rule and profile before summarising the remainder (default is 10, use 0 for unlimited)
